# Released sampler-snapshot fixtures

These are frozen snapshots emitted by *released* `gestaltdb` wheels, used by
`tests/test_released_snapshot_compatibility.py` to prove forward readability.
They are intentionally tiny (about 30 KB total) and are never regenerated by
the normal test run.

| Directory | Writer | Format | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dense_v1/` | `gestaltdb 0.10.2` | 1 | Dense graph, no lookup arrays (derived on load) |
| `dense_v2/` | `gestaltdb 0.12.1` | 2 | Dense graph with lookup arrays and completion manifest |
| `temporal_v2/` | `gestaltdb 0.12.1` | 2 | Edge-version history with corrections and a bounded window |

`expected.json` records, per fixture:

- the writer `gestaltdb_version` and `format_version`;
- the seeded `SamplerEngine` results the released wheel produced;
- temporal point/window results for the half-open boundary cases;
- a SHA-256 for every committed fixture file.

The test fails if an artifact changes without the manifest, so a current-code
rewrite cannot masquerade as an old-release artifact.

## Regenerating

Only regenerate when the declared compatibility range changes. Use one clean
virtual environment per pinned release; the working tree must not be installed.

```bash
uv venv --python 3.12 /tmp/venv-0.10.2
uv pip install --python /tmp/venv-0.10.2/bin/python 'gestaltdb[lmdb]==0.10.2'
/tmp/venv-0.10.2/bin/python tests/fixtures/released_snapshots/generate.py

uv venv --python 3.12 /tmp/venv-0.12.1
uv pip install --python /tmp/venv-0.12.1/bin/python 'gestaltdb[lmdb]==0.12.1'
/tmp/venv-0.12.1/bin/python tests/fixtures/released_snapshots/generate.py
```

The script detects the installed version, writes only that version's
directories, and merges its results into `expected.json`. Generated with
Python 3.12.3 and NumPy 2.5.4 on 2026-10-28.

## What this does not cover

- Snapshots written by the working tree: covered by the ordinary sampler and
  compatibility suites.
- Artifacts from unreleased commits or release candidates.
- Backward readability (current snapshots opened by old wheels), which is not
  a supported direction.
